qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the wiring harness on electrical cutout device?
What screw size is used for the wiring harness connection on distributor?
What is the torque value for the wiring harness connection on distributor?
Which component has the higher torque specification - the electrical cutout device or distributor connection?
qa_pairs.answer: The distributor connection has the higher torque specification at 10 Nm compared to 2.5 Nm for the electrical cutout device.

qa_pairs.question: What type designation is listed for the wiring harness on electrical cutout device?
What type designation applies to the wiring harness connection on distributor?
What section and subsection does this engine wiring harness information belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 12-12 Engine Electrical Equipment, subsection 12 51 Engine wiring harness.

qa_pairs.question: What screw size is specified for the electrical cutout device wiring harness?
How many different wiring harness connections are specified in this table?
qa_pairs.answer: Two wiring harness connections are specified: one for electrical cutout device (1AZ) and one for distributor (2AZ).
